title: Date, time and colour pickers
blurb: A clock for <input type="time">, a calendar for type="date" and swatches for type="color", each made of real buttons that a canvas moves and fades. Also every built-in form control drawn rotated in a canvas.
question: Date, time and colour inputs have pickers with no element to style. Can a canvas-drawn picker made of real buttons replace them on the same input, and what happens to the built-in controls when the input is drawn in a canvas?
result: The replacement pickers work with touch, mouse and keyboard. Built-in controls draw and work rotated. Their own pickers stay outside the canvas.
